title: Low-temperature chemical synthesis of nanocrystalline KTiOPO4

steps.description: Titanium tetrabutyl was mixed with acetyl acetone (ACAC) with a mole ratio of 1:1; then the mixture was dissolved in 2-ethoxyethanol.
PO(OR)3 solution was pre-synthesized by adding H2O with NH4OH (0.05 mol/Kg) at 50 °C to partially hydrolyze PO(C4H9)3.
The solution transformed into a gel after several days.
The gel was ground to a fine powder and heated at 500 °C to produce an amorphous precursor material.
The amorphous precursor powders were heat treated at various temperatures ranging from 550 to 850 °C with a definite interval of time.
